note: Bank Central Asia (BCA), a reporting bank, on its own education page (4 October 2023, read 2026-10-30) about OJK's debtor information (iDeb) from the Financial Information Services System (SLIK): the lender gives the collectability score when it reports to OJK; collectability 2 marks arrears of 1 to 90 days, 3 of 91 to 120, 4 of 121 to 180 and 5 over 180; the score shown in the iDeb report is shown for 24 months (two years), written as keep two years (the period the report shows, as Djibouti's file uses). A secondary source: OJK's own pages and its regulations on SLIK (ojk.go.id, an F5 'Request Rejected' page; idebku.ojk.go.id; peraturan.go.id and peraturan.bpk.go.id, no answer or Cloudflare) weren't read, and the bank's page cites no article. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported (the page says only that the lender scores it when it reports to OJK), so the days are the game's reading: the next monthly update. Re-read 2026-11-03: OJK's own guide to reading the iDeb report states it shows each facility's quality and days in arrears for the last 24 months, with the five quality codes by name, so the bureau and the two years are found on OJK's page and BCA's is no longer cited (BCA alone gives each code's range of days, which the game doesn't hold).
